source.quote: Audio-gd's own pages for the R-2 MK2, read 2026-11-25. « Fully discrete r2r ladder DAC »; « 4 group fully discrete R-2R DA converters work with push-pull mode »; « 2 fully discrete native DSD decoders »; « Built in mulriple OS and NOS modes »; « 3. Built-in 2X, 4X and 8X digital filters and NOS modes allow users to choose the tone that best suits their personal taste. »; « 7, DOP support from SPDIF input . » Spec rows: « Support Sampling | USB & IIS : 44.1kHz - 384kHz /32Bit DSD64-512 / Coaxial mode: 44.1, 48, 88.2, 96,176,192kHz »; « S/N Ratio | >110DB »; « THD+N | <0.02% »; « Output impedance | 10 ohm »; « Frequency Response | 20Hz - 20KHz (< - 0.5DB) ». The manual's reduced mode list reads « n : NOS mode. » with 2X, 4X and 8X oversampling. Inputs: USB, HDMI-IIS, coaxial. No optical row at all on this model, consistent with its input list.

facts.chip: « 4 group fully discrete R-2R DA converters work with push-pull mode » and « 2 fully discrete native DSD decoders ».

device_settings.why: The manual gives a reduced list - « n : NOS mode. » plus 2X, 4X and 8X - where the larger models offer two distinct NOS algorithms, N0 and N1. One NOS mode here, not two.

_conditions_NON_CONCLUANTES_chez_Audio_g: No terms page found on audio-gd.com, so no prohibition could be checked - which is NOT the same as finding no prohibition. Measured 2026-11-25: the English navigation has seven items (Home, Products, Warranty, Shop, Contact Us, Shipment, Chinese) and no legal link; terms.htm, legal.htm, Copyright.htm and Privacy.htm all 404; Warranty-EN.htm was read in full and is a repair-and-shipping policy with no clause on content. There is no robots.txt (404). Every page carries the same footer, quoted as printed: « Copyright(C) 2004 www.audio-gd.com All Rights Reserved » - a bare reservation that states no prohibition on quoting. Same reading as Burson, Mytek and MHDT Labs: recorded because nothing forbidding was found, with the quality of the check recorded beside it.
_NOS_chez_Audio_gd_veut_dire_NON_SUR_ECH: 109 pages of this site were searched for « New Old Stock » and « N.O.S. »: ZERO hits. And one page defines the term outright: « In the 1970'S, the first generation of CDP were released , and they used an NOS design . "NOS" stands for "Non Oversampling". Using a NOS design, specs are ordinary because the limited signal bit depth affects THD and S/N. » The valve products are where the other meaning would have appeared and it does not - the Vacuum HE-1 MK3's pages contain no occurrence of NOS at all. So vocabulary/nos-means-two-things.json is settled for this maker in the direction the catalogue cares about, and the three models carrying NOS in their NAME - R-1 NOS, R-28 NOS, NOS-1704, plus the NOS 7 / 11 / 19 line - are non-oversampling designs, not valve-stock marketing.
_lechelle_de_VOLUME_nest_pas_le_converti: Audio-gd's volume controls are relay-switched resistor attenuators and the maker never calls them ladders: the wording is « a four channels digital control relays based volume control, through changing the tolerance 0.05% resistors to control the volume ». No page on this site conflates that with its R-2R converter, which is the trap that cost a withdrawn claim on another brand. ACSS is likewise not a digital input: it appears only under Output Level, as « 2+2MA (ACSS) », and as an ANALOGUE input on the amplifiers.
_les_chiffres_publies_sont_ceux_du_mode_: Every spec table on this site is headed « Specifications tested by OS8 mode » - the published S/N and THD figures are measured with 8x oversampling running, not in the non-oversampling mode this record's `correctable` depends on. The maker is explicit about the cost: on the R-1 NOS page, « if you want good specs, the NOS design definitely is not for you. » So the numbers and the mode that matters to an upsampling engine describe two different states of the same device, and no measurement is carried into this record.
_un_176_kHz_que_son_grand_frere_nenumere: « Coaxial mode: 44.1, 48, 88.2, 96,176,192kHz » here, against the R-1 MK3's « 44.1, 48, 88.2, 96,192kHz » - the same maker, the same socket type, and 176.4 kHz present on one list and missing from the other. Both are enumerations, not ranges, so the omission is a statement. inputs.spdif_coax carries only the ceiling, 192000, because the schema has no field for a rate SET - which means this difference between two sibling products survives in this gloss alone.
